crossRefs.note: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?
Again he returned, and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy, and they didn’t know what to answer him.
How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep,
so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man.
By night on my bed, I sought him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.
I was asleep, but my heart was awake. It is the voice of my beloved who knocks: “Open to me, my sister, my love, my…
His watchmen are blind. They are all without knowledge. They are all mute dogs. They can’t bark— dreaming, lying down…
But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’
Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.
“So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day…
When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples, and found them sleeping because of grief,
Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us…
Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.
For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

translations.bsb: Otherwise, he may arrive without notice and find you sleeping.
